behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Idle extension cannot exceed absolute deadline and equality is expired.
Snapshot timestamps round-trip unchanged; rejected/expired touch does not mutate source.
docDelivery: Minimum idle/absolute deadline, pure timestamp-based evaluation and no system clock.
Snapshot shape/bounds, earlier-time rejection and distinct parse/state errors.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Pure state {created,lastSeen,idle,maxAge}; created integer0..1e12, ttl integer1..1e9, created<=lastSeen<created+maxAge; now safe integer>=lastSeen except rollback rejection. JSON snapshots ordinary unique keys, malformed syntax/shape included.
independence: Implement idle plus absolute session expiry, touch semantics and serialized clock-independent state.
